text:
People Ops: Quick update — we just published a short-term change to compassionate leave reimbursements for last-minute flight rebookings and a new PTO advance flow for same-day emergency coverage. Details and the claim form are here: https://redwood.internal/policies/compassionate-rebook (TL;DR below)

maria_hr: TL;DR please?

People Ops: TL;DR — if you need to rebook a flight within 48 hours of travel due to an immediate family emergency, Redwood will cover reasonable rebooking/change fees up to $600 and will auto-approve up to 2 days of PTO advance for that incident. File the claim within 14 days. Manager approval isn't required for the advance but we ask you to notify your manager ASAP. :heart:

aj_engineering: Is the $600 per person or per incident?

People Ops: Per incident. If multiple tickets are needed for the same emergency (e.g., partner + child), open separate claims and include receipts.

kena_manager: Any retroactive coverage for trips already rebooked last week?

People Ops: We're allowing retroactive claims for rebookings that happened back to 2025-12-01. Submit receipts and a short note in the form. We may follow up with a quick check.

lisa_travel: Quick note on expense categorization — use GL code COMP-TRV and tag the claim with "compassionate-rebook". The finance team will route those faster.

aj_engineering: How does the PTO advance affect time-off balances?

People Ops: Advance reduces your future accruals like a loan: the system will reconcile over the next 6 pay periods. If you transition out before it's reconciled, we'll coordinate a payroll adjustment.

maria_hr: Ops bot will post the published doc now.

ops_bot: Published policy document: https://redwood.internal/policies/compassionate-rebook — Form: https://redwood.internal/forms/compassionate-rebook. For questions, DM People Ops or open an HR ticket. :white_check_mark:

kena_manager: Thanks — can we get a one-pager for managers about how to support teammates in these cases?

People Ops: Yes — manager one-pager is attached to the policy doc. We'll also run a 20-min drop-in next Thursday at 10am PT to walk through common scenarios. Invite in #people-ops-calendar.

aj_engineering: Appreciated. One more — if someone is on Dedicated and in another country, does this apply?

People Ops: Applies globally, subject to local law. Travel stipend and tax treatment may differ by region; the policy doc has region callouts. If in doubt, DM People Ops with region and dates.

lisa_travel: Filing tip: upload a screenshot of the airline rebooking confirmation + payment receipt. That speeds approvals.

People Ops: Thanks everyone. We'll post the FAQ update after the drop-in. :sparkles:
